result.reason: The customer covenant is narrowed to Deerskin Products, limited to the term and twelve months, and includes the required development and acquisition carve-outs. However, HDI's separate exclusive right to use the Deerskin brand remains effective for the full term and is not clearly subject to the twelve-month cap or carve-outs, leaving a broader field-of-use restriction. The new third-party-site qualifier also unnecessarily creates tension with HDI's retained exclusivity and Section 6.2, potentially permitting a Company-operated non-closeout site. The run-on sentence and unclear commencement of the twelve-month period further reduce drafting quality.
